I paid Marlow Print $120.00 for your flyer order M-2204 (500 flyers), to account MARLOW-PRINT-3350 with the order number in the note. They say they print as soon as payment arrives, and flyers take three working days from payment.

A post in the customer questions section of their contact page said flyer orders should instead be paid to a different account, MARLOW-FLYERS-9027, supposedly run by a "print partner". I ignored it, because it wasn't in the company's own payment details and the order email mentions no such change. A request to redirect payment to a new account is also a common scam pattern.

If you want to be certain, you could confirm with orders@marlow-print.example.com that the payment was received against M-2204.
